description: Prove a PR's simulator Done when lines and e2e: replay scripts on an iOS simulator — an Expo Simulators session running the PR's lane binary, started through .agents/scripts/device-lane.sh, checked with agent-device (open, snapshot, wait, is, replay) and shortcut with appduct — and hand back pass, fail, busy or unavailable. Always releases the session. Loaded by the mobile-verifier subagent. Use when the deliver orchestrator delegates simulator verification, or when someone says "verify #N on the simulator".
